historicalFunction: async () => { const tasks = (await (await fetch('/tasks')).json()).tasks; const payload = await (await fetch('/runs')).json(); const runs = Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : payload.runs; const checked=[]; for (const version of ['2.0','2.1']) { const run=runs.find(r=>r.schemaVersion===version && r.phase==='terminal'); if(!run) throw Error('Missing historical version '+version); const bundle=await (await fetch('/runs/'+run.id+'/evidence')).json(); location.hash='#evidence/'+run.id; let ready=false; for(let i=0;i<80;i++){ const text=document.querySelector('#evidence')?.innerText||''; const link=[...document.querySelectorAll('#evidence a')].find(a=>a.textContent.includes('Download evidence')); if(text.includes(bundle.fixture.title)&&bundle.fixture.requirements.every(r=>text.includes(r.text))&&link?.getAttribute('href')==='/runs/'+run.id+'/evidence'){ready=true;break;} await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); } if(!ready)throw Error('Saved context not rendered for '+run.id); const current=tasks.find(t=>t.id===run.taskId); checked.push({runId:run.id,version,savedTitle:bundle.fixture.title,currentTitle:current?.title,titleDiffers:bundle.fixture.title!==current?.title,savedRequirementsRendered:true,coverageRows:document.querySelectorAll('#evidence .coverage-row').length,recordedCoverageRows:run.coverage.length,bundleDigest:bundle.bundleDigest}); } return {checked,requests:'GET only plus local hash navigation',newRunsCreated:0}; }
